topic: Is Edinburgh Castle open on Mondays in winter, and how much is a ticket?

text: Is edinburgh castle open on mondays in winter? And how much is a ticket. Want to check before we book anything

@claude is Edinburgh Castle open on Mondays in winter (December to February), and what is the adult ticket price? 🙂

I couldn't open the official page, so this comes from a search summary of it. It said the castle is open daily, including Mondays, from 9.30am to 5pm between October and March. The adult ticket was £23.50 online or £26 at the gate. Other sites disagreed, so check https://www.historicenvironment.scot before you book.
